caption: These spinach egg bites are always a win 🤍 Soft, fluffy, Good for babies & toddlers and perfect for baby led weaning or the whole family. Ingredients: • 3 eggs • ½ cup cottage cheese • 1 tbsp cream cheese • Onion powder • Spinach • Cheddar cheese Directions: Blend eggs, cottage cheese, cream cheese, and onion powder until smooth. Spray a muffin pan, add spinach and cheddar cheese, then pour in the egg mixture. Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 15–18 minutes, until set. Storage: Fridge up to 3 days • Freezer up to 1 month Save this for later & follow for easy toddler meals ✨ #toddlerbreakfast #eggbites #babybreakfast #babyledweaning #babyrecipes
